x: The full result appears below and it will be seen that we had nine home in the first ten; Dyke, the Police champion, who finished third, being the only M.P.A.A. man to trouble our runners.
Unfortunately, in the final Dyke's leg muscle broke down, but even with that misfortune our team finished third, the winning team's time being slower than that recorded by our boys in their heat.
Dyke third off 7 yards. In the two miles event we had our three other Internationals out, and what a fine race this was!

A programme of three events gave only a few of our Juniors a chance to show their merit; but Mewes, Crilly, Keyworth, Dyke, Martin, Chantler and Clements certainly seized the opportunity to show their superiority over the other clubs.
A Belgrave team of Dyke, Bone and Mewes was entered. Evidently it was a regular race as previous times of 10.8 etc are given and winners had been Poly and Blackheath.
